cues.label: Farm report
cues.words: You're listening to seven sixty, Esker Farm Service. Good evening from the feed room.

cues.label: Farm report
cues.words: Milk trucks are taking the county roads tonight. Brush the snow off your tank vent before the hauler gets there.

cues.label: Dance hour
cues.words: The Thursday hall dance is on tape. Here's the Pine Row Trio with the Forty Acre Polka.

cues.label: Co-op desk
cues.words: Before we go back to the desk, the co-op has twine and salt by the west door. Bring your own shovel.

cues.label: Overnight country
cues.words: Ninety-nine seven. Tamarack Country. We keep the porch light on.

cues.label: Community calendar
cues.words: That's Sunday at River Lanes, by the Cedar Street Band. League bowlers, your score sheets are still at the counter.

cues.label: Community calendar
cues.words: The west bridge supper is postponed. Keep the tickets. They'll take them whenever the kitchen opens again.
